scope: SCOPED to the collective (en bloc) sale, one module. s 84A(1) (majorities), (2A), (2B), (4), (6), (6A), (6B) (objections, the Strata Titles Board, stop orders, the High Court route), (7), (7A), (7B), (8) (the objector's grounds and top-ups), (9) (good faith), and s 28 (no adverse possession of common property).
